name: Glpi
description: GLPI (Gestionnaire Libre de Parc Informatique) is a free, open-source IT Service Management (ITSM) platform used for IT asset management, helpdesk, and service desk operations.
composeYaml:
services:
  glpi:
    image: 'glpi/glpi:11'
    environment:
      - GLPI_DB_HOST=glpi-db
      - GLPI_DB_PORT=3306
      - 'GLPI_DB_NAME=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-glpi-db}'
      - 'GLPI_DB_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'GLPI_DB_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'glpi-data:/var/glpi:rw'
    depends_on:
      glpi-db:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://localhost/'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
  glpi-db:
    image: 'mysql:8'
    volumes:
      - 'mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql'
    environment:
      - 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=${ROOT_PASSWORD}'
      - 'MYSQL_DATABASE=${MYSQL_DATABASE:-glpi-db}'
      - 'MYSQL_USER=${MYSQL_USER}'
      - 'MYSQL_PASSWORD=${MYSQL_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - mysqladmin
        - ping
        - '-h'
        - 127.0.0.1
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10
